T8/T10 must account for terrain relief along rays as well as object height; extend coverage or mark unknown when actual ray reach exceeds available geometry. Below 10 degrees, mark unsupported/unknown; night is a separate state.

reach_evidence.policy: Check actual sunward height/relief/reach and gaps; unsupported rays stay unknown
